description: NaBaScSi₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.66 Å. Ba is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to eleven O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.13 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.24 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-50°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.68 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Ba, one Sc, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ba, one Sc, and one Si atom.
